sloka: गिरे: सानूनि रम्याणि चित्रकूटस्य सम्प्रति ।वारणैरवमृद्यन्ते मामकै: पर्वतोपमै: ॥ २.९३.९॥
transliteration: gire: sānūni ramyāṇi citrakūṭasya samprati ।vāraṇairavamṛdyante māmakai: parvatopamai: ॥ 2.93.9॥

translations.english: The enchanting ridges of mount Chitrakuta are now trampled by my mountainlike elephants.
